criteria.text: A cluster is upgraded to the next Kubernetes version while a test application keeps serving
criteria.how: Upgrade a cluster carrying a load test and watch for errors.

criteria.text: A namespace with a stateful application is restored to another cluster after being deleted
criteria.how: Delete a test namespace with its volume, then restore it elsewhere.

criteria.text: A deployment that breaks the policy (unapproved image, privileged pod) is refused, with a clear message
criteria.how: Try to deploy one and read the refusal.

criteria.text: A new cluster is created from a template and ready for a team in under an hour
criteria.how: Create one through the platform and hand it to a team.

criteria.text: Each team sees what its namespaces use and cost for the month
criteria.how: Show the cost view to two team leads.

A container registry and the approved images
